findings.title: The 18 % chatter pass line rests on the averaged (zero-ripple) trip fraction; with drop-outs of a few ms, trains that pass both numeric criteria (< 10 ms, < 18 % of any 100 ms window) turn a worst-case U9 off at 5.73, 5.96 and 6.0 V
findings.contradicts: REQUIREMENTS F6 bench acceptance: 'the open fraction in any 100 ms window stays below 18 % (an open fraction above about 20-24 % turns U9 off however short each drop-out is; with D402 the worst-case trip is about 20 % at 5.73 V, so the root set the pass line at 18 % from that physics)'; the same rule in ORDERING 8.3 (line 617), R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF line 68, R10_VALIDATION R23-POWER-02 / R24-TRI-02 rows and AGENTS section 1. TI SLVSFC9C p9 thresholds (VUVLO(F) 1.076-1.116 V, IENLKG +-0.1 uA).

evidence.topology: board 92c3ad59: BAT_IN-R80 470k-J400.1/J400.2 (D402.1 to GND)-R165 470k-BAT_ENABLE=U9.1; R81 300k and C87 220 nF from BAT_ENABLE to GND (pcbnew pad nets).
evidence.model: Worst-case corner as the records use it (R80/R165 +1 %, R81 -1 %, C87 0.72 x 220 nF, U9 EN sink 0.1 uA, D402 50 nA, VUVLO(F) 1.116 V). Closed: C dV/dt = (Vb - Id R80 - V)/(R80+R165) - V/R81 - Ien; open: C dV/dt = -V/R81 - Ien - Id. tau_closed 35.8 ms, tau_open 47.0 ms. The averaged model reproduces the records (20.0 % / 24.4 % at 5.73 / 6.0 V, en_model.out), but that is only the d -> 0 limit: each drop-out of length d lowers EN by about (V/R81+I) d / C below the mean.
evidence.time_domain_counterexamples: Starting from the closed steady state (train_sim.out): 6.0 V, 8.0 ms open every 50 ms (max 16.0 % in any 100 ms window, longest 8 ms): U9 off at the 3rd drop-out. 6.0 V, 9.5 ms every 92 ms (17.5 %): off at the 2nd. 5.96 V (the stated 10 ms pack floor): 8.0 ms every 50-60 ms (16.0 %): off at the 2nd-3rd. 17 such trains at 5.96 V and 7 at 6.0 V on a coarse grid; all pass '< 10 ms' and '< 18 %'.

findings.impact: The two numeric criteria are the only part of the rule that covers a worst-case board (the functional 'U9 stays on' check runs on one bench board, whose nominal trip fraction is 26.4-30.4 %). As written they accept switch chatter that turns a worst-case U9 off at 5.73-6.0 V; the statement that the worst-case trip is about 20 % is true only for sub-millisecond drop-outs.
findings.concrete_fix: Restate the rule in F6, ORDERING 8.3, R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF, R10_VALIDATION and AGENTS: record the J400 contact state (>= 10 kS/s) under flight vibration and pass only if that record, replayed through the worst-case EN model above at 5.73 V (or the chosen pack floor), keeps EN above 1.116 V; or give the allowed open fraction as a function of the longest drop-out (e.g. at 5.73 V: < 17 % for drop-outs <= 2 ms, < 13 % for <= 5 ms, < 5 % for <= 8 ms); or run the functional test with C87 replaced by 150 nF. Correct 'the worst-case trip is about 20 %' to the d -> 0 limit.

findings.title: Post-trip hold-up 0.157-0.182 ms / 0.44-0.48 ms is computed from 5.3 V, above the stated PA6 trip window (VLOGIC 4.84-5.17 V); from the window it is 0.104-0.164 ms / 0.29-0.43 ms
findings.contradicts: REQUIREMENTS F6 'the trip window is VLOGIC about 4.8-5.2 V (PA6 0.44-0.47 V) ... hold-up after the trip is 0.157-0.182 ms with all ports on and 0.44-0.48 ms with the camera off / shed (Calculation, from 5.3 V at 300.8 uF)'; the same in M3_R10 lines 616 and 1017-1018, ORDERING 8.3 line 674, R10_VALIDATION rows 5 and 25 ('about a third of the break-to-3.8 V figures').

evidence.divider: PA6 = VLOGIC_SENSE: R60 100k (VLOGIC) / R61 10k (GND), C60 10 nF; ratio 11. 0.44-0.47 V x 11 = 4.84-5.17 V. C84 (470 uF, counted 300.8 uF) is on VLOGIC, the same node PA6 senses (pcbnew pad nets).
evidence.load_powers: From parts_budget.json battery_break_ride_through_ms c_camera_radio_gps_on_C300.8uF_to_3.8V 0.4642-0.5391 ms over 7.4 -> 3.8 V: P = 0.5 x 300.8 uF x (7.4^2 - 3.8^2) / t = 13.06-11.25 W. Camera off / shed: 4.66-4.30 W (from the records' 0.441-0.478 ms at 5.3 V).
evidence.calculation: t = 0.5 C (Vtrip^2 - 3.8^2) / P. 5.3 V: 0.157-0.182 ms (the records' figure). 5.17 V (window top): 0.142-0.164 ms; 4.84 V (window bottom): 0.104-0.120 ms. Camera off / shed: 0.397-0.430 ms at 5.17 V, 0.290-0.315 ms at 4.84 V. Fraction of the break-to-3.8 V figure: 0.22-0.30, not 'about a third' (0.339 at 5.3 V). holdup.out
evidence.origin: round23_power.json computed trip_5.3V and trip_5.0V cases with the window not yet chosen; the records then fixed the window at 4.8-5.2 V but kept the 5.3 V figures.

findings.impact: The owner hold-up question (R10_VALIDATION row 25) and firmware's shed budget are sized on a hold-up overstated by 11-52 %.
findings.concrete_fix: Quote the post-trip hold-up over the window: 0.104-0.164 ms with all ports on and 0.29-0.43 ms with the camera off / shed (300.8 uF, Calculation), and 'about a quarter' of the break-to-3.8 V figures, in F6, M3_R10, ORDERING 8.3 and R10_VALIDATION rows 5 / 25; or state a 5.3 V trip and move the window.

findings.title: Operating assumptions 'Pack' row still gives U9's turn-off corner without D402's leakage (4.778 / 4.811 / 4.851 V); with it the corner is 4.802 / 4.835 / 4.875 V, and F6 in the same file says 4.80 V
findings.contradicts: REQUIREMENTS F6 / R10_VALIDATION row 25 / D-R24-19: 'U9's 4.80 V BAT_IN turn-off corner (4.78 V before D402's leakage)'. The Pack row: 'R10 calculation: 4.778 V at 25 C resistor temperature; including the fitted resistors' +-100 ppm/K drift gives 4.811 V at 70 C ... The separate 125 C sensitivity is 4.851 V'.

evidence.calculation: Vin_off = (VUVLO(F) (1/(R80+R165) + 1/R81) + Ien)(R80+R165) + Id R80, VUVLO(F) max 1.116 V, Ien +0.1 uA (TI SLVSFC9C p9), Id 50 nA (Infineon ESD103 Rev 1.3, the records' figure), resistor corners +-1 % / +-1.45 % (70 C) / +-2 % (125 C): without D402 4.778 / 4.811 / 4.851 V (the row's figures), with D402 4.802 / 4.835 / 4.875 V (corner_tcr.out).

findings.impact: Two statements of the same corner in one file disagree; the Pack row's 70 C figure (4.811 V) understates the corner the PA6 trip edge (4.84 V) must stay above by 24 mV.

observations: F6 / F9 EN figures reproduce exactly with D402: drop-out worst 6.30 / 8.20 / 10.35 / 20.11 / 26.02 ms (5.5 / 5.73 / 6.0 / 7.4 / 8.4 V), nominal 19 / 33 / 41 ms, pack floor 5.956 V, turn-on 30.3-130.3 ms and 88 / 56 / 45 ms, averaged trip 20.0 / 24.4 %.

F9 bench ramp window reproduces: turn-off 4.288-4.802 V (nominal 4.505), turn-on 4.723-5.251 V (nominal 4.960); leakage directions (to GND raises, from IN lowers) are right; outcome (b) 2-3 uA gives 6.4-7.5 V turn-off (records 'about 6.5-7.4 V').
F9 D402 numbers reproduce: 5.69 mV EN shift; 14.3 mV C87 rise; unclamped 7.48 V nominal / 9.6 V worst.
F1's 9 C allowance is for 30 s; for the 35 s window it is about 7.8 C, which F1 itself says to recompute (disclosed).
